notes: One sequential before/after observation on a shared host; no controlled timing or universal memory claim.
All native score summaries and numerical payload bytes must agree; this comparison is not an independent source-genotype oracle.

record.scope: Synthetic mixed REF/ALT additive diploid GT model on 22 autosomes; score reconstruction only. No phenotype, portability or clinical-performance validation.
record.oracle: Integer 10^-4-unit source formulas, original global ordinals, independently reproduced mask protocol. No engine pack/table/contribution as oracle input.
